transcript.content: Hi, I’m glad you came in. What brings you in today?

Hello, Doctor. Thank you for seeing me. I, uh, I hope I'm not taking up too much of your time. I wouldn't want to be a bother. 

I came because... well, it's a little hard to say, and I don't want you to think I'm foolish. But lately, the men down at the domino table, and... and sometimes even the radio announcer... they've been giving these little messages. Just meant for me, you see. My wife, she tells me it's just regular talk and I shouldn't fret, but... I just know they are warning me to be careful. 

I hope it's alright that I came to talk to you about it. I'm trying to do what I'm supposed to. Am I explaining it okay for you, Doc?
Do you ever hear a voice speaking to you when no one is actually there?

Well... I, um... I hope you won't think less of me for saying this. I don't want you to think my mind is going bad. It's nothing scary, I promise. 

Just... some afternoons, when the house gets real quiet, I'll hear my old friend. I'll hear him call my name from out on the porch, or sometimes he's just humming an old choir song. It sounds so clear, Doc, just exactly like he is standing right there next to me. 

I know he ain't really there, but... well, it's almost a comfort, you know? Is that... is that the sort of thing you were asking about? I hope that doesn't make me sound too foolish.
Have there been times lately when you felt confused about where you were or what time it was?

Oh, no, sir. I, uh... I don't think so. I mean, my memory ain't quite what it was when I was a younger man, of course, but I always know I'm sitting right here in my own living room, or down at the park. And I keep a good eye on the clock, too. I wouldn't want to miss my wife's suppertime, you know? 

I hope that's the right answer. I try real hard to keep my wits about me, Doc. I really do. Am I doing okay?
Have you recently had a time when you felt unusually full of energy?

Well, I... I suppose there are times like that, yes. I hope it doesn't sound like I'm making a fuss. It's just... sometimes I wake up and I just feel so spry, you know? Like I've got a whole lot of pep in my step, maybe more than a man my age usually does. 

When that energy comes on, I just want to be helpful. I don't want to just sit around being a burden. So I'll get out there and start cleaning up the yard, and then maybe I'll find a chair that needs fixing, and before you know it, I'm writing up little plans for the church committee and moving the furniture around the house... all in the exact same morning. 

My wife says I tire her out just watching me, but I'm just trying to be productive, you see? I hope that's alright to do. It's not a bad thing to want to get chores done, is it, Doc?
When you get those energetic spells, do you need less sleep than usual?

Well, I... I guess I do sleep a bit less when I'm feeling like that. I hope that's not a bad sign, Doc. 

It's just... on those nights, I might only lay down for, oh, maybe two or three hours. And then my eyes just pop open before the sun's even up. But the thing is, I don't feel tired at all! I feel right as rain, ready to get to work just like I'd slept the whole night through. 

I just figure, if the good Lord gives me the energy, I ought to use it, right? It's better than lying in bed staring at the ceiling and keeping my wife awake. That makes sense, doesn't it? I'm not doing anything wrong by getting up early, am I?
During those high-energy times, do you feel unusually important or specially gifted?

Well, I wouldn't say I think I'm better than anybody else, Doc. I try to stay humble, just like I was taught. But... I suppose when I'm feeling real spry like that, I do get this feeling that... well, that maybe I'm the only one who can really bring the neighborhood together, you know? 

It's not that I think I'm a big shot or anything! It's just... I get so sure of myself. I feel like I've got this special knack for getting folks to listen to me and go along with my ideas for fixing things up around the community. Like I'm meant to be the one leading the charge. 

I don't say it out loud too much because I don't want to sound boastful. It's not a sin to want to help your neighbors, is it? I just want to be useful, Doc. That's a good thing, right?
Have there been times when the messages and your friend's voice happened even when you were not in one of those high-energy spells?

Well, I... I suppose so, yes. I hope you don't think less of me for it, Doc. I know it sounds a bit odd. 

But, well, there was a time... oh, maybe a quiet month or so... where I was sleeping just fine. Right through the night, like a normal fella. And I wasn't running around with all those big plans for the neighborhood or anything. I was just taking it easy, like my wife likes me to.

But even then... I still heard my friend out on the porch. And... well, I still felt sure the radio was sending me those little messages. 

It wasn't bothering anybody, though! I just kept to myself about it. It's okay that it happened when I was feeling calm, isn't it? I wasn't making a fuss or anything. I just want to make sure I'm giving you the right answers, Doc.
Have you had a period when you felt depressed most of the day, nearly every day?

Well, no, not really. I mean... I have my days, just like anybody else my age. You know, when the weather's bad or my joints are aching a bit more than usual. But I wouldn't call it feeling down most of the day, every day. 

I try to keep a positive attitude, Doc. My wife always says I'm pretty good at looking on the bright side. I don't want to be one of those grumpy old men who just sits around complaining all the time. That wouldn't be very pleasant for anybody, would it? 

So, no, I don't think I've had a time like that. I hope that's the answer you're looking for. I'm doing my best to give you the whole picture here.
About how long have the messages and your friend’s voice been going on?

Well, let's see... I suppose it's been a little while now. Not too long, though! I'd say... maybe around nine months? On and off, you know. 

It's not like it's an everyday bother, Doc. Just here and there, when things are quiet. I hope that doesn't make me sound too far gone or anything. I've been managing just fine, really I have. Nine months isn't such a terribly long time, is it? I just want to make sure I'm giving you the right timeline so you can help me best.
Before these experiences started, had you had any major medical illness, stroke, head injury, or seizure?

Oh, no, no, nothing like that. I've always been pretty healthy, thank the Lord. No strokes or seizures or... or anything scary like a head injury. 

I mean, I've got the usual aches and pains for a fellow my age, maybe a little high blood pressure that the doc at the clinic keeps an eye on, but... nothing major before all this started. I've always tried to take good care of myself, you know? Kept active, ate right... mostly. 

I hope that's a good thing, Doc? It means my brain is still mostly in good shape, right? I'd hate for you to think I was falling apart or anything.
Have you ever believed that someone was controlling your thoughts or putting thoughts into your mind?

Well, no, not controlling my thoughts. That sounds awful, doesn't it? Like something out of a science fiction picture show. I've always been my own man, Doc, clear-headed and all. 

But... well, I did want to mention... I mean, I came in today because... well, sometimes when I'm down at the domino table with the fellas, or even just listening to the radio announcer, they... they slip in these little messages. Just for me. 

Now, my wife, she tells me it's just regular talk and I'm making a mountain out of a molehill. But I know they're warning me to be careful about things. It's not them putting thoughts in my head, though! It's just... friendly advice, maybe? I hope that doesn't sound too strange, Doc. I'm just trying to be honest with you so you can tell me I'm doing okay. I am doing okay, aren't I?
Was there ever a period of at least two weeks when you were not having one of those high-energy spells, but you still heard your friend’s voice or believed the radio was sending you messages?

Well, yes, actually. There was... let's see, it was maybe a month or so back. I was sleeping just fine, you know, regular hours, and I wasn't rushing around with all those big plans I sometimes get. I was just having a nice, quiet month. 

But, well... I did still hear my friend talking out on the porch during that time. And the radio... I still felt like the announcer was slipping in those little warnings for me. 

I know that probably sounds a bit odd, since I wasn't all wound up or anything. I was feeling perfectly calm, really! It's just... those things kind of stuck around for a bit even when I was feeling steady. That's not too unusual, is it, Doc? I hope I'm explaining it right so you can see I'm mostly keeping it together.
During the past nine months, have there been times when the messages and your friend’s voice were happening even though you were not in one of those high-energy spells?

Well, gosh, the whole past nine months? I... I'm not rightly sure about all that time. Other than that one quiet spell I just told you about, I haven't really noticed it happening when I'm just... you know, my regular self. 

I try to just focus on the good days. I certainly don't want you thinking I'm sitting around hearing things all year long! I'd hate for you to think I was losing my marbles. I've been keeping pretty steady, mostly. Just doing my chores and minding my own business. 

So, I don't think it's been happening a whole lot besides that one time I mentioned. I hope that's okay, Doc? I really am doing my best to stay on an even keel, just like I'm supposed to. I'm being a good patient, right?
Over these past nine months, were the messages and your friend’s voice present for most of that time?

Well, I wouldn't say they've been there *most* of the time, no sir. Not constantly, anyway. It's just... well, they've been coming and going, on and off, for about nine months now. 

It's not like they're bothering me every single day! Just... here and there, a little bit at a time over these past months. I try not to pay them too much mind, honestly. I don't want to make a big fuss over it. That's the right way to handle it, isn't it, Doc? Just take it in stride and not let it get the better of me?
Was there ever a full month when you were not having one of those high-energy spells, but you still heard your friend’s voice or felt the radio was sending you messages?

Well, yes sir, like I was mentioning just a little bit ago... it really was a full month. I had a nice, quiet month where I was sleeping normally every night, and I wasn't full of all those big plans like I get sometimes. I was behaving myself just fine. 

But... yes, even during that quiet time, I still heard my friend out on the porch, and I still believed that radio was speaking to me. I wasn't causing any trouble over it though, I promise you that. I hope it's okay I'm telling you this again, I just want to make sure I'm giving you the right answers. I'm doing okay, aren't I, Doc?
